extractions.extraction_text: Hidrantes exteriores: Uno si la superficie total construida esté comprendida entre 5.000 y 10.000 m2. Uno más por cada 10.000 m2 adicionales o fracción.

attributes.satisfied_if: (BUILDING.AREA.TOTAL_CONSTRUCTED >= 5000 AND BUILDING.AREA.TOTAL_CONSTRUCTED <= 10000 AND FIRE.HYDRANTS.OUTDOOR.COUNT >= 1); OR (BUILDING.AREA.TOTAL_CONSTRUCTED > 10000 AND FIRE.HYDRANTS.OUTDOOR.COUNT >= (1 + CEILING((BUILDING.AREA.TOTAL_CONSTRUCTED - 10000) / 10000)))

attributes.norm_statement: A fire detection and alarm system must be installed, including detectors, manual call points, and the ability to transmit local alarms, general alarms, and verbal instructions.
attributes.satisfied_if: FIRE.DETECTION_SYSTEM.INSTALLED == TRUE AND FIRE.ALARM_SYSTEM.INSTALLED == TRUE AND FIRE.DETECTION_SYSTEM.DETECTORS.INSTALLED == TRUE AND FIRE.ALARM_SYSTEM.MANUAL_CALL_POINTS.INSTALLED == TRUE AND FIRE.ALARM_SYSTEM.TRANSMISSION.LOCAL == TRUE AND FIRE.ALARM_SYSTEM.TRANSMISSION.GENERAL == TRUE AND FIRE.ALARM_SYSTEM.TRANSMISSION.VERBAL_INSTRUCTIONS == TRUE
